outcome: Impedance cardiography values (mean arterial pressure, systemic vascular resistance, thoracic fluid content)
finding: This study established normative impedance cardiography values for the second half of pregnancy and up to 48 hours postpartum, finding that values generally fall within the normal range and can be used to assess patients with complicated pregnancies.
mod_finding: Thoracic fluid content was higher after cesarean delivery compared to vaginal delivery and antepartum measurements.
